ranking.name: Volibear
ranking.why: Q is 'hold left stick toward them, then auto' — hall sticks beat a virtual joystick. W is targeted bite + heal. E shield needs you inside the bolt: melee tap is enough, or GameSir gesture-swipe E toward screen center for a true on-feet pre-cast. R is a huge landing zone that also turns the tower off, so dives do not delete you.
ranking.skip_if: Vayne / kite-heavy range + disengage; they never let you bite twice.

ranking.name: Warwick
ranking.why: Q is targeted sustain, analog stick helps stay in bite range, R is one dash skillshot. Easy 1v1s when the fear + Q heal line up. Weaker pick after the ult cooldown hit.
ranking.skip_if: You need Baron lane, or they have heavy anti-heal + range.

ranking.name: Garen
ranking.why: Zero aim: Q targeted silence, E spin around you, W self-cast, R execute. Best raw X3 mapping. Loses long 1v1s to true duelists and is less unkillable mid-fight than Voli/Sett.
ranking.skip_if: Fiora, Vayne, or any lane that kites the spin forever.

ranking.name: Sett
ranking.why: E pull + grit W makes him a brawler who lives the first burst. W cone center and R throw-angle need right-stick aim — doable on X3 Pro, but more miss-prone than Voli's targeted bite.
ranking.skip_if: Poke/kite comps that never let you stack grit.

ranking.name: Mordekaiser
ranking.wr_note: S-tier baron on several 7.2/7.3 lists; high ban
ranking.why: R is a forced 1v1 with stolen stats — closest thing to 'easy 1v1' in the kit. W shield is tanky. Q facing + E pull are skillshots, so overlay aim is worse than point-and-click Voli/Garen.
ranking.skip_if: Fiora, Gwen, Vayne — they win the isolated duel.

ranking.name: Dr. Mundo
ranking.wr_note: B-tier baron on 7.2d lists — unkillable, not a duelist
ranking.why: Hardest to actually kill. Cleaver Q is a skillshot; E is an auto reset. Loses clean 1v1s to %HP / true-damage bruisers.
ranking.skip_if: You asked for easy 1v1s, not just a walking HP bar.

ranking.name: Jax
ranking.wr_note: S baron on several 7.2/7.3 lists; scales, weaker early
ranking.why: Leap is targeted, E is a button-hold dodge. Analog spacing around E is a controller superpower. Not 'easy' until items, and not as tanky as Heartsteel Voli.
ranking.skip_if: You want to win lane at 3, not at 2 items.

ranking.name: Olaf
ranking.why: R makes him unstoppable in the 1v1. Axes are skillshots you must pick up — overlay aiming + pathing is messier than targeted Voli W.
ranking.skip_if: You do not want to chase axes on a mapped right stick.

ranking.name: Darius
ranking.wr_note: Often S+/S baron; dunk 1v1s, not a tank
ranking.why: Bleed + dunk wins most melee 1v1s. Analog stick is great for Q outer-ring. He is not hard to kill — if the dunk is not ready, he loses the 'unkillable' check.
ranking.skip_if: You wanted to survive messy fights, not win a bleed race.

ranking.name: Aatrox
ranking.wr_note: A-tier; revive + drain, three Q sweet spots
ranking.why: Sustain 1v1s are real. Three directional Qs on a touch overlay are the opposite of X3-Pro-friendly.
ranking.skip_if: You are on a mapped gamepad.

ranking.name: Fiora
ranking.wr_note: C-tier on 7.2d baron list; best pure duelist, not easy
ranking.why: Wins 1v1s, dies if vitals/parry are late. Analog stick helps vital dancing; W parry window is a poor overlay-button skill.
ranking.skip_if: You asked for easy and hard to kill.
